text:
alex: Help! Assembling a ~4hr road‑trip playlist for Fri. Thinking upbeat 90s alt/indie vibes. Also planning a late‑night movie — leaning neo‑noir or weird indie. Any recs? :car: :popcorn:
ela: 90s alt is perfect for driving. Pavement, Superchunk, Guided By Voices. Drop in some Modest Mouse for peaks.
samir: Pavement yes. Add Sonic Youth - "Bull in the Heather" and Liz Phair for a few tracks. For neo‑noir movie recs: "Brick" (Rian Johnson) is excellent.
chloe: If you want newer stuff with that energy, Bad Suns + Alvvays are good. For late‑night oddball: "Under the Silver Lake" or "Blue Ruin" depending on mood.
ela: Quick poll — react with :one: for 90s alt roadtrip, :two: for modern indie pop roadtrip.
alex: dropping a starter playlist (add tracks): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXcF6B6QPhFDv?si=example 
spotify-bot: Playlist "alex's roadtrip mix" created. Collaboration enabled :rocket:
samir: Also recommend "Inherent Vice" if you want a messy, hazy noir vibe.
chloe: "Only Lovers Left Alive" is slow/moody if you're after atmosphere (not traditional noir).
alex: tally so far: :one: samir, :one: ela, :two: chloe — 90s alt takes it so far :metal: 
ela: curated 90s chunk to add: Pavement - Cut Your Hair / Sonic Youth - Bull in the Heather / Guided By Voices - I Am A Scientist / Modest Mouse - Trailer Trash
samir: throw in Stereolab - French Disko for a weird spike.
alex: lovely. Movie night in the lounge at 9pm after sync? Who's in? :popcorn:
chloe: I'm in.
ela: can't make it but have fun!
alex: thanks all — playlist shaping up. Will ping when movie setup is ready.
